summary_md: **taly ([@zxtheidiot](https://x.com/zxtheidiot/status/2116308504923566523))** open-sources **abra**, an inference engine for Pascal (sm_61) GPUs without tensor cores, reaching about 115 tok/s decode on Qwen3-4B with old GTX 1080 Tis ([talystalys/abra](https://github.com/talystalys/abra)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - talystalys/abra: High-performance LLM inference engine for NVIDIA Pascal GPUs (sm_61). Custom DP4A microkernels, autotuned MMVQ, and dual-GPU NCCL tensor parallelism.

relevance: Reviving old GPUs for local inference.
